urls.rationale: Title 24 Art. 6 (Colorado Sunshine Law) Part 3 (Regulation of Lobbyists): the lobbying-disclosure statute body.
Title 24 Art. 6 Part 1 (General Provisions): definitions cross-referenced by Part 3.
Article 18.5 (Independent Ethics Commission): enforcement linkage for lobbying / ethics violations.

notes: Title 24 page uses categorical groupings rather than flat article listing; required intermediate fetch (pass2_administration.tsv) before article-6 was reachable. Then article-6 itself is a Parts-level TOC, requiring a further drill (pass3_article-6.tsv) to reach Part 3 (Regulation of Lobbyists).
